tools.name: list_incidents
tools.title: List Incidents
tools.description: Retrieve a paginated list of incidents with optional filtering by state, priority, category, caller, assignee, or assignment group. Returns summary information for each incident.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 10, max: 100)

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default: 0)

data_quality.description: Filter records by data quality. clean_only is the new default and excludes defective/augmentation records. dirty_only returns only defective records. all returns everything, matching the old behavior for callers that previously received dirty records.

tools.name: get_incident
tools.title: Get Incident
tools.description: Retrieve the complete details of a specific incident, including all comments, work notes, and related entity information.

incident_id.description: The incident ID to retrieve (format: INC-XXXXXX)

data_quality.description: Filter records by data quality. clean_only is the new default and excludes defective/augmentation records. dirty_only returns only defective records. all returns everything, matching the old behavior for callers that previously received dirty records.

tools.name: create_incident
tools.title: Create Incident
tools.description: [Mock operation — changes are not persisted] Create a new incident in the system. Requires caller ID, short description, category, and priority. Returns the newly created incident with auto-assigned ID and system fields.

caller_id.description: User ID of the person reporting the incident

short_description.description: Brief one-line summary of the issue (max 160 characters)

tools.name: update_incident
tools.title: Update Incident
tools.description: [Mock operation — changes are not persisted] Update an existing incident. Can modify state, priority, assignment, description, or add work notes. Provides full updated incident details.

description.description: Updated description (appends to existing description with timestamp)

incident_id.description: The incident ID to update (format: INC-XXXXXX)

assigned_to_id.description: User ID to assign the incident to

assignment_group_id.description: Assignment group ID to route the incident to

tools.name: add_comment
tools.title: Add Comment
tools.description: [Mock operation — changes are not persisted] Add a comment or internal work note to an incident. Comments are visible to end users; work notes are internal only.

text.description: The comment or work note text

type.description: Type of comment: public comment or internal work note

author_id.description: User ID of the comment author

incident_id.description: The incident ID to add the comment to

tools.name: list_users
tools.title: List Users
tools.description: Retrieve a list of users with optional filtering by department or name search. Returns user summary information.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default: 10, max: 100)

offset.description: Number of records to skip for pagination (default: 0)

data_quality.description: Filter records by data quality. clean_only is the new default and excludes defective/augmentation records. dirty_only returns only defective records. all returns everything, matching the old behavior for callers that previously received dirty records.

tools.name: get_user
tools.title: Get User
tools.description: Retrieve complete details for a specific user including department, contact information, and status.

user_id.description: The user ID to retrieve (format: USR-XXXX)

data_quality.description: Filter records by data quality. clean_only is the new default and excludes defective/augmentation records. dirty_only returns only defective records. all returns everything, matching the old behavior for callers that previously received dirty records.

tools.name: create_user
tools.title: Create User
tools.description: [Mock operation — changes are not persisted] Create a new user account in the system. Returns the newly created user with assigned user ID.

tools.name: list_assignment_groups
tools.title: List Assignment Groups
tools.description: Retrieve all assignment groups available in the system. Groups define team responsibility areas for incident routing.

data_quality.description: Filter records by data quality. clean_only is the new default and excludes defective/augmentation records. dirty_only returns only defective records. all returns everything, matching the old behavior for callers that previously received dirty records.

tools.name: get_assignment_group
tools.title: Get Assignment Group
tools.description: Retrieve complete details for a specific assignment group.

group_id.description: The assignment group ID to retrieve (format: GRP-XXXX)

data_quality.description: Filter records by data quality. clean_only is the new default and excludes defective/augmentation records. dirty_only returns only defective records. all returns everything, matching the old behavior for callers that previously received dirty records.

tools.name: create_assignment_group
tools.title: Create Assignment Group
tools.description: [Mock operation — changes are not persisted] Create a new assignment group for routing incidents to teams. Returns the newly created group.

incidents.shortDescription: Network connectivity issues in Building C
Unable to reset password through self-service portal

comments.text: Investigating database logs. Found memory exhaustion on PRODDB01. Starting recovery process.
Restarted database service. Running consistency checks now.

INC-000001.description: The primary production database server (PRODDB01) stopped responding to queries at approximately 14:30 UTC. All database-dependent applications are experiencing timeouts. Recent configuration changes to replication settings may be involved.

comments.text: Confirmed issue in Exchange Online. Contacted Microsoft support for assistance.

INC-000002.description: Multiple users reporting inability to send or receive emails intermittently. Issue appears to be affecting the Exchange Online connector. Affects approximately 40% of user population.

comments.text: Identified VLAN misconfiguration on core switch. Restored correct routing rules. Testing network connectivity now.
All workstations in Building C are now back online. Connectivity verified across all test points.

INC-000003.description: All network ports in Building C third floor are down. VLAN routing appears to be misconfigured after recent network maintenance. Approximately 60 workstations affected.
INC-000003.shortDescription: Network connectivity issues in Building C

comments.text: Initiated immediate incident response protocol. Isolating affected domain controller from network. Reviewing access logs from past 24 hours.

INC-000004.description: Unauthorized access attempt detected on domain controller. Multiple failed login attempts from external IP followed by successful access using compromised credentials. Immediate investigation and containment required.

INC-000005.description: User unable to access the Finance shared folder (\\fileserver\finance). Receives permission denied error despite being a member of Finance group. Issue started this morning.

INC-000006.description: User's external monitor connected via HDMI is not displaying any signal. Adapter and cables appear intact. Built-in laptop display works fine.

comments.text: Waiting for Marketing department lead to confirm if printer is still needed in current location. Will investigate further once confirmation is received.

INC-000007.description: The HP LaserJet Pro M479 printer in Marketing is showing offline status. Users cannot send print jobs. Printer is powered on and network cable is connected.

comments.text: Reviewed VPN server logs. Found possible firewall rule timeout issue. Escalating to firewall team for review.

INC-000008.description: Remote user experiencing frequent disconnections from corporate VPN. Disconnects happen every 15-20 minutes. User is able to reconnect manually but issue impacts productivity.

comments.text: Reproduced issue in test environment. Appears to be related to recent permissions change on application config folder. Reviewing permission audit logs.
Found the root cause: NTFS permissions were inadvertently changed during a batch update yesterday. Restoring correct permissions now.

INC-000009.description: Custom reporting application crashes immediately upon launch with error code 0x80070005 (Access Denied). Issue affects multiple users. Application was functioning correctly yesterday.

comments.text: Identified backend service timeout on identity verification API. Increased timeout threshold and restarted service. Portal now operational.

INC-000010.description: User unable to complete password reset using the IT self-service portal. Process times out at the identity verification step. Affects multiple users attempting resets.
INC-000010.shortDescription: Unable to reset password through self-service portal
